support_question: How can interval usage help reduce winter bills during an outage?
research_question: What evidence supports prioritizing outage safety before winter energy savings?

sources.title: SYNTHETIC utility service catalog
sources.text: Winter Energy Insights provides interval consumption summaries and bill-saving guidance. Outage Alerts provides utility interruption notifications. Solar Explorer provides renewable energy planning information.

sources.title: SYNTHETIC customer support policy
sources.text: Interval usage helps identify winter consumption peaks; savings are not guaranteed. During an outage, keep away from downed lines and report hazards to the utility. The fictitious SYN-SUB-ALDER-01 site is not a customer access point.

sources.title: SYNTHETIC emissions ledger
sources.text: Illustrative January 2026 emissions: 42.5 kgCO2e. This is a synthetic reported figure, not a measured customer footprint.
